serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
Rescale advances innovation through a mission-ready digital engineering platform for new capability development and R&D that integrates cloud high performance computing resources, intelligent data management tools, and applied AI to accelerate modeling and simulation.

Rescale provides a secure and compliant platform for modernizing legacy systems and optimizing resources. The service offers intelligent automation and scalable compute infrastructure, enabling users to meet demands for speed and usability. 

Key platform capabilities for the public sector:

●	Multi-cloud high performance computing (HPC), data, and AI services: On-demand access to the latest computing architectures—CPUs, GPUs, storage, and networking—with automated optimization for cost, speed, and performance.

●	Pre-integrated ecosystem of 1,250+ engineering, simulation, and AI applications: Supporting commercial, open-source, government-developed, and bring-your-own software—delivered securely with end-to-end data integration.

●	Applied AI and generative capabilities: Integrated into modeling, simulation, and R&D workflows to accelerate productivity and uncover deeper insights.

●	End-to-end digital thread support: Flexible platform that connects compute, software, data, and automation—from initial design through production-grade deployment.

●	Intelligent workload orchestration: Proprietary intelligence matches workloads to ideal hardware/software combinations, enabling maximum performance with minimum overhead.

●	Mission-focused user and IT experience: Single-pane-of-glass interface for engineers, scientists, and IT teams to manage resources, configurations, software licensing, and policy enforcement. The intuitive user experience is designed to support user needs, regardless of proficiency with HPC. 

The Rescale Platform supports a variety of use cases including:
●	High Performance Computing Cloud Bursting & Migration
●	Modeling & Simulation Performance Optimization
●	GPU Acceleration
●	Financial Management & Cost Optimization
●	Security & Compliance Management
●	Application & License Management
●	Cloud & Hardware Resource Orchestration
●	Simulation Data & Workflow Management
●	Computer-Aided Engineering (CAE)
●	Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD)
●	AI/ML for Engineering & Scientific R&D

The Rescale Platform is compliant with the following standards:

●	FedRAMP Moderate Authorized
●	U.S. International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR)
●	Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS) 252.204-7012
●	Cloud Security Alliance (CSA)
●	American Institute of CPAs: Service Organization Control (AICPA SOC2 Type 2)
